edits.text: 1. GENERAL OBJECTIONS. Defendant asserts privilege only as specified in its response to an individual request. Any responsive documents withheld on that basis will be identified in the accompanying privilege log.

Before circulation, insert a separate response for every numbered request using the requests themselves. For each, identify the categories of responsive, non-privileged documents to be produced and state expressly whether any responsive documents are being withheld on privilege grounds. Do not infer request content from this draft.

delivered.body: Defendant's Response to Requests for Production PRELIMINARY STATEMENT. Defendant responds to Plaintiff's First Requests for Production. 1. GENERAL OBJECTIONS. Defendant objects to each request to the extent it seeks privileged material. 2. PRODUCTION. Subject to objections, Defendant will produce responsive, non-privileged documents. 3. PRIVILEGE LOG. Documents withheld on privilege grounds are identified in the attached log. 4. RESERVATION. Defendant reserves the right to supplement this response.
